verdicts.decision_note: The client requires the front page to render the rating reasons and primary weaknesses so the customer's result is immediately clear.
The client confirms that the report design, including the front-page result presentation, must apply consistently across all four report files.
The client changes the rendered result explanation to concise, easily scanned bullet points with less page-one detail; no existing value key becomes obsolete.
First concrete failure: the client observed that the reviewed page-one result panel contained too much text to scan quickly.
